name: Earthquakes
overview: Scripture reveals that earthquakes are powerful manifestations of God's presence and judgment, as seen when Mount Sinai quaked under His descent in fire (Exodus 19:18) and when the earth opened to swallow Korah and his followers (Numbers 16:31-32). The psalmist describes the earth shaking and the foundations of the hills moving in response to God's wrath and rebuke (Psalms 18:7, 15), while Job acknowledges God's sovereignty in shaking the earth from its place (Job 9:6). These passages underscore that earthquakes serve as both literal and symbolic demonstrations of God's authority over creation.
